question: Among all superheroes with blue eyes, find the full name of the one who is the slowest (lowest Speed attribute) but still has above-average weight for their race.

prediction.sql:
WITH race_avg_weight AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_025 AS race_id, AVG(s.XCL_029) AS avg_weight
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_025
),
blue_speed_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_020 AS full_name, s.XCL_025 AS race_id, s.XCL_029 AS weight, ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
)
SELECT bsh.full_name
FROM blue_speed_heroes bsh
INNER JOIN race_avg_weight raw ON bsh.race_id = raw.race_id
WHERE bsh.weight > raw.avg_weight
ORDER BY bsh.speed_value ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH race_avg_weight AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_025 AS race_id, AVG(s.XCL_029) AS avg_weight
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_025
),
blue_speed_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_020 AS full_name, s.XCL_025 AS race_id, s.XCL_029 AS weight, ha.XCL_011 AS speed_value
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN colour c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue' AND a.XCL_004 = 'Speed'
)
SELECT bsh.full_name
FROM blue_speed_heroes bsh
INNER JOIN race_avg_weight raw ON bsh.race_id = raw.race_id
WHERE bsh.weight > raw.avg_weight
ORDER BY bsh.speed_value ASC
LIMIT 1
